{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df = trial_df.loc[trial_df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Check the distribution of severity across arms and sex
print("Severity distribution across arms and sex:")
severity_cross_tab = pd.crosstab(trial_df['arm'], [trial_df['sex'], trial_df['severity']], normalize='index').round(3)
print(severity_cross_tab)

# Check the response rate stratified by sex and severity
print("\nResponse rate by sex and severity:")
response_by_sex_severity = trial_df.groupby(['sex', 'severity'])['responded'].mean().round(3)
print(response_by_sex_severity)"}
